Generates 3 optional parts:
* A header (level 3) containing version information (to turn this off, pass <code>h=no</code> or <code>h=0</code> to the template)
* A link to the corresponding release notes (at [[cv:Release information]]<nowiki>;</nowiki> to turn this off, pass <code>rn=no</code>
* The list of download mirrors (to turn this off, pass <code>m=no</code>

Examples:
<pre>{{download|0.34.11}}</pre>
{{download|0.34.11}}
----
<pre>{{download|0.34.10|m=no}}</pre>
{{download|0.34.10|m=no}}
----
<pre>{{download|0.31.25|h=0}}</pre>
{{download|0.31.25|h=0}}
